sentences.text:
The Hon'Ble Sri Justice K.Sarath
 Writ Petition No.17213 of 2024
Order:

This writ petition is filed under Article 226 of Constitution of India seeking following relief:
"...to issue a writ order or direction more particularly one in the nature of Writ of Mandamus declaring the impugned action of the respondents in passing the impugned Award in File No.AA/60/2016 dated 10/10/2019 (which is antedated and is communicated through notice dated: 06/02/2020) for acquisition part of Residential Flat premises of the petitioners bearing the H.No.2-2-1089/314, Happy Home Apartments, Golnaka, Hyderabad for the purpose of road widening as illegal,
arbitrary violative of Article 14 of the constitution of India apart from provision of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013

consequently direct the Respondents to initiate acquisition proceedings for remaining portion of the subject flat as per Section 94 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 in view of the orders made in similar case vide W.P.No.7056/2020 dt.16/08/2022 and W.P.No.3676/2022 dt.17/10/2022..."
2.

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, learned Government Pleader for Land Acquisition and learned Standing Counsel for G.H.M.C appearing for the respondents, and perused the material on record.

Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that in similar matter pertaining to the same apartment, this Court passed common order in W.P.Nos.7056 of 2020 and 37643 of 2018, dated 16.08.2022 by allowing the W.P.No.7056 of 2020 and requested to pass similar order in this writ petition also.
4. The learned Government Pleader for Land Acquisition and learned Standing Counsel for G.H.M.C have not disputed the submissions made by the learned counsel appearing for the petitioner.

5. In view of the submissions made by both sides, this writ petition is allowed in similar lines as this Court passed orders in W.P.No.7056 of 2020 dated 16.08.2022 and directing the respondents to initiate acquisition proceedings for remaining portion of the subject flat under the provisions of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, SK,J 2013 and pay compensation to the petitioner within a period of two (02) months from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.

opennyai_summary.decision:
This writ petition is filed under Article 226 of Constitution of India seeking following relief:
"...to issue a writ order or direction more particularly one in the nature of Writ of Mandamus declaring the impugned action of the respondents in passing the impugned Award in File No.AA/60/2016 dated 10/10/2019 (which is antedated and is communicated through notice dated: 06/02/2020) for acquisition part of Residential Flat premises of the petitioners bearing the H.No.2-2-1089/314, Happy Home Apartments, Golnaka, Hyderabad for the purpose of road widening as illegal,
arbitrary violative of Article 14 of the constitution of India apart from provision of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
5. In view of the submissions made by both sides, this writ petition is allowed in similar lines as this Court passed orders in W.P.No.7056 of 2020 dated 16.08.2022 and directing the respondents to initiate acquisition proceedings for remaining portion of the subject flat under the provisions of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, SK,J 2013 and pay compensation to the petitioner within a period of two (02) months from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.
The petitioner shall not be dispossessed from the subject flat until award is passed for the remaining portion of the subject flat as directed above.
The Registry is directed to enclose the copy of the common order passed in W.P.Nos.7056 of 2020 and 37643 of 2018, dated 16.08.2022 along with this order.
7. Miscellaneous petitions, if any, pending shall stand closed.
